name: heyou
description: Heyou's relationship-intelligence server for ChatGPT. Connects with your Heyou login and answers questions about paths, relationship strength and next steps from your organization's relationship data.

interface.longDescription:
Heyou shows you who in your network, and your teammates' networks, can get you into the accounts you're selling to, and how strong those relationships really are.

Ask in plain language and Heyou answers from your own Heyou account:
• Find a path into a company: who knows someone there, and who the strongest introducer is
• Map your team's relationships into an account
• Explain a single relationship: how strong it is, why, and when it was last active
• See what to do next across your target accounts
• See the recent public posts and publications of the people you're trying to reach
• Correct a relationship score when you know better (ChatGPT asks you to confirm first)

Every answer shows its working: a conclusion, the evidence behind it, a confidence level, alternatives, and what Heyou couldn't determine. Relationship strength is shown as High, Medium or Low, never a made-up percentage. Long lists say how many results there are in total.

Requires a Heyou account. Learn more at heyou.io.
defaultPrompt: Who on my team can get me a warm intro to Snowflake?
What should I do next to get into my target accounts this week?
Map our relationships into Datadog and tell me who's the strongest way in.
